sentences.text: My name is Emili and I'm very happy you are here today.
In this episode, we will talk about a big,
beautiful and colorful country.
This country is called Brazil.
Brazil is in South America.
It is famous for football, music, dance,
festivals and nature.
Brazil is a place full of life and energy.
Listen carefully and try to understand.
I will speak slowly and clearly.
Let's begin.
Where is Brazil?
Brazil is in South America.
It is the largest country in South America
and the fifth largest country in the world.
Brazil is so big that it touches almost every country
in South America except Chile and Ecuador.
Brazil is next to Argentina, Paraguay, Bolivia, Peru,
Colombia, Venezuela, Guyana, Suriname and French Guiana.
It also has a long coastline along the Atlantic Ocean.
The capital city of Brazil is Brasilia.
Brasilia is a modern city with unique buildings.
The largest city in Brazil is Sao Paulo.
Sao Paulo is very busy and has many people.
Another famous city is Rio de Janeiro.
Rio is known for its beaches, its music
and its big statue called Christ the Redeemer.
The statue is on a mountain and looks over the whole city.
What is Brazil famous for?
Brazil is famous for many things.
Let's talk about some of them.
Football soccer.
Brazil is very famous for football.
It is the most popular sport in the country.
Children play football in schools, parks and on the beach.
Brazil has won the World Cup five times.
That is more than any other country.
Famous football players like Pele, Ronaldinho
and Neymar are from Brazil.
Carnival is a big festival.
It happens every year before Lent.
During carnival people dance, sing and wear colorful costumes.
There are parades with music and dancing in the streets.
The biggest carnival is in Rio de Janeiro,
but many cities celebrate it too.
Amazon rainforest.
Brazil is home to the Amazon rainforest,
the largest rainforest in the world.
It is full of trees, plants, rivers and animals.
The Amazon River is also one of the longest rivers in the world.
Many scientists and tourists visit the Amazon
to learn about nature and see wild animals.
Beaches.
Brazil has many beautiful beaches.
Some famous ones are Copa Cabana and Epanema in Rio de Janeiro.
People go there to swim, relax, play sports or listen to music.
What is the food like in Brazil?
Brazilian food is very tasty and full of flavor.
It is a mix of indigenous, African and Portuguese traditions.
People in Brazil eat a lot of rice, beans, meat and fresh fruits.
Some popular dishes include phasuata.
This is a black bean stew with different kinds of meat.
It is usually eaten with rice, parofa, toasted cassava flour,
and orange slices.
Poned occasional.
These are small cheese breads.
They are crispy outside and soft inside.
People eat them for breakfast or snacks.
Moqueca.
This is a seafood stew made with fish, coconut milk,
onions and peppers.
It is cooked slowly and served with rice.
Asai.
Asai is a purple fruit from the Amazon.
It is cold, sweet and eaten like ice cream.
People mix it with bananas, granola and honey.
Topioca.
This is a flatbread made from cassava flour.
It is filled with cheese, meat or coconut
and eaten as a snack or breakfast.
For drinks, people enjoy fruit juices made from mango,
pineapple, passion fruit or guava.
People also drink guarana, a sweet soft drink made from a local fruit.
Culture and people.
People in Brazil are very friendly, joyful and welcoming.
They like to celebrate, dance and spend time with family
and friends.
Most people in Brazil speak Portuguese, not Spanish.
Portuguese is the official language.
Brazil is a multicultural country.
People have roots from Europe, Africa,
Indigenous tribes and Asia.
This mix creates a rich and colorful culture.
Music and dance are very important in Brazilian life.
Two famous styles are samba.
Samba is fast and rhythmic.
It is the main music of carnival.
Bossa Nova.
This is a slow, soft music.
People often listen to it on the beach or at cafes.
Brazilians love to dance.
You can see people dancing at festivals, parties or even in the streets.
Nature and animals, Brazil is one of the most biodiverse countries in the world.
It has rainforests, mountains, rivers, waterfalls, wetlands and deserts.
Some special animals in Brazil are jaguars, sloths, toucans, parrots,
pink river dolphins, monkeys.
Brazil has many national parks to protect its nature.
One famous park is Pantanal, the world's largest wetland.
It is perfect for seeing birds, fish and wild animals.
Festivals and traditions.
In addition to carnival, Brazil has many local festivals.
People celebrate music, religion, food and history.
Some important ones are...
Festa Junina.
A festival in June with country music, dancing and traditional clothes.
New Year's Eve in Rio.
People wear white and go to the beach to watch fireworks and throw flowers into the sea.
Parenans Festival.
A colorful festival in the Amazon region with music and traditional stories.
Brazilians love to celebrate and enjoy life.
Conclusion?
Brazil is a wonderful country with so much to offer.
It has big cities, peaceful nature, fun music,
delicious food and kind people.
Whether you love the beach, the rainforest, dancing or football,
Brazil is a great place to explore.
Would you like to visit Brazil one day?
I hope you learned something new today.
